branding.title: Website branding
branding.logoHint: Shown in the top banner in place of the site name. Recommended: {{recommendedHeight}} px tall, up to {{recommendedMaxWidth}} px wide (it renders at {{displayHeight}} px tall, so double that keeps it sharp on high-density screens). PNG or WebP with a transparent background works best. Max {{maxMb}} MB.
branding.noLogo: No logo set — the banner shows the site name.
branding.logoTooLarge: That image is {{size}} MB. The limit is {{max}} MB.
branding.warnShort: shorter than the {{height}} px banner, so it will look small
branding.warnSoft: may look soft on high-density screens
branding.warnWide: very wide, so it will be capped to fit beside the navigation
branding.faviconHint: Shown on the browser tab, in bookmarks and in history. A square {{recommendedSize}}×{{recommendedSize}} px PNG, ICO or WebP works best; a transparent background keeps it legible on both light and dark tab strips. Max {{maxKb}} KB.

branding.nameHint: Shown in the banner when no logo is set. Each language has its own name, so the banner reads correctly in both.

settings.title: System Settings
settings.directoryEnabledHint: Turn this off on an installation with no directory: it hides the AD Users page, which could otherwise only ever report a connection failure. Signing in is not affected — accounts already imported keep authenticating against the directory.
settings.accessTokenMinutesHint: How long a sign-in lasts before the application quietly renews it. Shorter means a revoked account, or someone removed from a group, loses what their token still carries sooner.
settings.refreshTokenDaysHint: How long someone may stay away and still return without signing in again. Must be at least as long as the access token.
settings.maxRows: Row limit for previews and lookups
settings.maxRowsHint: Caps what is read in one go on the paths that hold a whole result in memory: the preview of a write query, the before-change snapshot it records, and the options behind a dropdown parameter. The results grid is not affected — it caches the full result and pages through it — and exports are never capped.

permissions.intro: Every capability the system offers, and which roles hold it. Admin always holds everything and cannot be edited — that is what keeps this page reachable. Changes take effect on the next request; nobody has to sign in again.
permissions.addRoleHint: The role is created with no permissions. Tick what it may do in the grid, then Save.
permissions.deleteRoleMessage: "{{name}}" will be deleted along with its permissions. Accounts holding it must be moved to another role first.

hints.queries.view: Opens Manage Queries and a query definition — without the SQL unless the next one is also held.
hints.queries.readSql: Shows the SQL on the list, in the editor and in an export. Without it a query can be granted but not read.
hints.queries.manage: Create, edit and delete queries, their parameters and their Word templates.
hints.queries.transfer: Export query definitions to JSON and import them back. Exports carry the SQL.
hints.queries.run: Opens My Queries and History, and runs whatever has been granted to this account.
hints.access.manageQuery: Decide who may reach one query. The finer-grained of the two — grants accumulate quietly.
hints.access.manageGroup: Decide who may reach a query group, and so everything inside it.
hints.queryGroups.manage: Create, rename and delete the folders queries are organised into.
hints.userGroups.view: See the groups and who is in them. Needed to grant anything to a group.
hints.userGroups.manage: Create groups and change membership. Nobody may add their own account, whatever this says.
hints.users.view: See the accounts on the system and the roles they hold.
hints.users.manage: Create accounts, reset passwords, assign roles, activate and deactivate. Administrator accounts stay out of reach of anyone but an Admin.
hints.directory.view: Read the department list and the accounts already imported.
hints.directory.manage: Search Active Directory, import accounts, revoke, restore and sync.
hints.databaseUsers.manage: Create and edit the database connections queries run through, including their credentials.
hints.scheduledTasks.viewAll: See every scheduled task and its history. Without it, only tasks this account was named a viewer on.
hints.scheduledTasks.manage: Create, edit, delete, run and cancel scheduled tasks.
hints.scheduledTasks.download: Download the files a run produced, for any task. A per-task viewer grant can allow this for one task instead.
hints.logs.view: Read the query execution log and the before-change snapshots it records.
hints.audit.view: Read the trail of administrative actions — including changes made on this page.
hints.branding.manage: Upload or remove the logo in the top bar.
hints.settings.manage: Change the runtime settings on the tab beside this one.
hints.roles.manage: Edit this page: create roles, delete them, and change what any role may do.
